findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 22, SAVE Act (Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act)
findings.note: House Clerk roll call 102 records Strong voting Yea on passage. The bill requires documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. It passed the House.

findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 8281, Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act
findings.note: House Clerk roll call 345 records Strong voting Aye on passage of the 2024 SAVE Act bill, which required documentary proof of citizenship to register. The roll call lists the vote as Aye.

findings.motion: On Motion to Recommit, H.R. 8281, Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act
findings.note: House Clerk roll call 344 records Strong voting Nay on the motion to send the 2024 SAVE Act bill back to committee. The motion failed.
